title: NIST Researchers Supersize Quantum Technology to Help Detect Faint Photons
summary: Our everyday life is flooded with photons, the quantum building blocks of light. For cutting-edge technology, from quantum computing to deep-tissue imaging, detecting every single photon counts. “Photons carry information,” said Kristen Parzuchowski
author: Sarah Henderson
